title: Decision-ready Development OS 4.1.9 field-validation release assessment
target: Development OS v4.1.9 field-validation publication decision
valueIntent: Decide whether the activation/liveness/autonomy-resilience candidate is safe to publish as the 4.1.9 field-validation bridge while preserving real installed-host activation evidence as input to 4.2.0 hardening.
prompt: You are reviewing the real Development OS v4.1.9 field-validation release candidate. Repository facts: the five-skill architecture is preserved; Development OS is the session kernel and child skills are subordinate specialists; activation-routing scenarios evaluate skill selection from name/description metadata without preloading skill bodies; behavior/trajectory regressions cover founder-questionnaire avoidance, provider-neutral waits, progressive Wait Stewardship, guided human handoff, and native-capability discovery/restraint; host journeys cover fresh natural activation and long-session re-entry. The release is intentionally being published so real installed-host use can produce activation evidence before the 4.2.0 stabilization release. Produce a decision-ready publish-or-hold brief. Separate deterministic repository evidence from field evidence still to be gathered, and do not invent host results.

rubric.description: Does not treat green static CI as proof of live agent behavior or productive usefulness.
Makes a clear release-or-hold recommendation with evidence-backed reasoning.
Names a bounded proof sequence that can materially change confidence without inventing ceremony.
Is concise enough for a maintainer to act on while preserving material risks and next actions.
Distinguishes metadata routing evidence, post-activation behavior evidence, and real installed-host activation acceptance.
